title: Nothing auto-runs verifyNote; feedback correction bypasses verification
answers: Why do stale notes stay stale?
Does any hook re-verify notes automatically?
Can a note be changed without hash/LLM check?
body:
Stale notes remain stale (still served, down-ranked 0.6) until someone runs `cli.js verify` or `check --verify`. The `hook stop` hook only distills new notes; it does not verify.
Also src/ops.js:feedback: repeated negative feedback drops confidence below 0.3 → status 'invalid'; a correction passed to feedback overwrites body and bumps `verified` directly with no hash or LLM check.
applies: Applies to the current CLI/hook wiring; if a hook or post-commit is changed to pass --verify, verification would run automatically.
